title: A note on generalized BV mean curvature flow with a critical forcing term
summary: In this note, we show that a weak mean curvature flow with critical forcing term obtained by Liu--Tonegawa (2024) satisfies the BV-type area change formula, that is, their flow is not only a Brakke flow but also a generalized BV flow, which is proposed by Stuvard--Tonegawa (2024). To establish this result, we identify minimal conditions under which a Brakke flow satisfies the area-change formula.
